fields.description: Issue of Miami Life (Vol. 9, No. 4) dated October 13, 1934. Includes Wen L. Phillips' "Notebook" column discussing local reactions to the Cardinals–Tigers World Series incident involving Ducky Medwick and player Owen, and extensive commentary on Miami Beach politics and gambling interests, including references to Dan Mahoney, Val Cleary, Abraham Frank Katzentine, and Sanders Gramling. Contains radio schedules for WQAM/WIOD, horse-racing coverage and tips ("Jockey Jimmy"), local society/"Round the Town" items, and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and entertainment venues; also notes an upcoming wrestling bout featuring Gene Delmont and Bogie Saab and a boxing match involving Al Rodriguez and Joe Knight.
